import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { setImmediate as yieldTurn } from 'node:timers/promises';
import { CatalogError } from './types.js';
import { retrieveAnswerContext } from './answer-context.js';
import { OperationBudget } from './operation-budget.js';
import { LexicalReadAccount } from './lexical-read-account.js';
import { CaptureWork } from './native-capture-work.js';
import { CodePathsV2 } from './code-paths-v2.js';
import { chooseQuestionRoot, SelectionUnavailable } from './question-path-selection.js';
import { decodeProjection } from './native-receipt-projection.js';
import { encodeNativeReceipt } from './native-receipt.js';
import { bytes, hash, same, requireReceipt } from './native-receipt-json.js';
import { compactQuestionPath, inputSpan, preparedQuestionPrompt } from './question-context.js';
import { assertQuestionCurrent, authorizeQuestionScope, questionSnapshot, questionSourceIds, readQuestionSnapshot } from './question-witness.js';
import { questionPreparationLimits, questionPreparationVersion, questionPromptVersion, questionWitnessVersion } from './question-preparation-types.js';
const owners = new WeakMap();
function fail(code, message) { throw new CatalogError(code, message, 409); }
const errorCode = (error) => error && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error
    && typeof error.code === 'string' && /^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,63}$/.test(error.code) ? error.code : 'QUESTION_FAILED';
const isThenable = (value) => value !== null && (typeof value === 'object' || typeof value === 'function') && 'then' in value;
/** Internal only: one transient slot per exact store; no queue, saved receipt or model. */
export class QuestionPreparations {
    analysis;
    options;
    shared;
    unsubscribe;
    observation = null;
    constructor(analysis, options = {}) {
        this.analysis = analysis;
        this.options = options;
        const store = analysis.catalog.store;
        let shared = owners.get(store);
        if (!shared) {
            shared = { stopped: false };
            owners.set(store, shared);
        }
        this.shared = shared;
        this.unsubscribe = analysis.catalog.onBoundaryChange(() => this.discard('fenced', 'QUESTION_SCOPE_FENCED'));
    }
    discard(status, reason) {
        const shared = this.shared, entry = shared.entry;
        shared.active?.controller.abort();
        if (!entry)
            return;
        if (entry.timer)
            clearTimeout(entry.timer);
        delete entry.snapshot;
        delete entry.expires;
        delete entry.timer;
        entry.state = { ...entry.state, status, reason, reviewedHash: null };
        shared.terminal = entry;
        delete shared.entry;
    }
    busy() {
        if (this.shared.stopped)
            fail('SERVICE_STOPPED', 'Question preparation is stopping.');
        if (this.shared.active || this.shared.answer || this.shared.configuration
            || this.analysis.catalog.store.one("SELECT 1 FROM answer_attempts WHERE status IN ('preparing','running') LIMIT 1"))
            fail('QUESTION_BUSY', 'Finish or cancel the current question operation first.');
    }
    find(id) {
        const entry = this.shared.entry?.state.id === id ? this.shared.entry : this.shared.terminal?.state.id === id ? this.shared.terminal : undefined;
        if (!entry)
            fail('QUESTION_NOT_FOUND', 'This preparation is unavailable. Find context again.');
        return entry;
    }
    ready(id, reviewedHash) {
        const entry = this.find(id);
        if (entry.state.status !== 'ready' || !entry.snapshot)
            fail('QUESTION_NOT_READY', 'Find and review current context first.');
        if (performance.now() >= entry.expires) {
            this.discard('expired', 'QUESTION_EXPIRED');
            fail('QUESTION_EXPIRED', 'Find context again after the preview expires.');
        }
        try {
            const value = readQuestionSnapshot(entry.snapshot);
            assertQuestionCurrent(this.analysis.catalog, value.context, value.witness.sourceIds);
            if (reviewedHash !== undefined && entry.snapshot.reviewedHash !== reviewedHash)
                fail('QUESTION_REVIEW_CHANGED', 'Use the exact reviewed context.');
            return { entry, snapshot: entry.snapshot, ...value };
        }
        catch (error) {
            if (!(error instanceof CatalogError && error.code === 'QUESTION_REVIEW_CHANGED'))
                this.discard('fenced', errorCode(error));
            throw error;
        }
    }
    get(id) {
        const entry = this.find(id);
        if (entry.state.status === 'ready') {
            try {
                this.ready(id);
            }
            catch { /* The terminal state is the polling response. */ }
        }
        return { ...this.find(id).state };
    }
    review(id) {
        const { entry, context, witness } = this.ready(id);
        return { ...entry.state, context, compact: witness.compact, selection: witness.selection, promptVersion: witness.promptVersion };
    }
    start(requestId, question) {
        if (typeof requestId !== 'string' || !/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,100}$/.test(requestId))
            fail('INVALID_REQUEST', 'Use a bounded preparation request ID.');
        if (typeof question !== 'string' || !question.trim() || bytes(question) > 2000)
            fail('INVALID_QUESTION', 'Enter a question of at most 2,000 UTF-8 bytes.');
        const questionHash = hash(question.trim()), previous = [this.shared.entry, this.shared.terminal].find(row => row?.state.requestId === requestId);
        if (previous) {
            if (previous.questionHash !== questionHash)
                fail('CONFLICT', 'This request ID has a different question.');
            return this.get(previous.state.id);
        }
        this.busy();
        const store = this.analysis.catalog.store;
        if (store.one("SELECT 1 FROM code_analyses WHERE status='running' LIMIT 1"))
            fail('QUESTION_ANALYSIS_BUSY', 'Wait for code analysis to finish or pause it before finding context.');
        const buildId = store.project().publishedBuildId;
        if (!buildId)
            fail('NOT_READY', 'Index sources before finding context.');
        if (this.shared.entry)
            this.discard('expired', 'QUESTION_REPLACED');
        const entry = { questionHash, state: { id: randomUUID(), requestId, status: 'preparing', reason: null, reviewedHash: null } };
        const controller = new AbortController();
        let finish;
        const done = new Promise(resolve => { finish = resolve; });
        this.shared.entry = entry;
        this.shared.active = { controller, done };
        // Reservation precedes even a synchronous internal checkpoint or worker.
        void this.prepare(entry, question, buildId, controller.signal).catch(error => {
            if (this.shared.entry === entry)
                this.discard(controller.signal.aborted ? 'cancelled' : 'failed', errorCode(error));
        }).finally(() => { delete this.shared.active; finish(); });
        return { ...entry.state };
    }
    async prepare(entry, question, buildId, signal) {
        const catalog = this.analysis.catalog, store = catalog.store;
        let budget, lexical, paths, nativeReads = 0;
        try {
            budget = new OperationBudget({ ...this.options.budget, signal });
            const checkpoint = async (info) => { await this.options.checkpoint?.(info); };
            const work = new CaptureWork(catalog, budget, signal, { checkpoint });
            await yieldTurn();
            await checkpoint({ stage: 'lexical' });
            work.check();
            lexical = new LexicalReadAccount(budget);
            const account = lexical;
            const context = await store.withPreparedReads(() => store.withLexicalReads(account, () => retrieveAnswerContext(catalog, question, buildId)));
            const { dependencies } = work.dependencies(buildId), sourceIds = questionSourceIds(context, { dependencies });
            assertQuestionCurrent(catalog, context, sourceIds);
            let selection = null, receipt = null;
            let compact = { item: null, reason: null };
            paths = new CodePathsV2(this.analysis, { checkpoint, selectRoot: async (resolution, pathWork) => {
                    const selected = await chooseQuestionRoot(resolution, context, pathWork);
                    selection = selected.observation;
                    return selected;
                } });
            try {
                nativeReads++;
                const projection = await paths.read({ buildId }, 'paths', signal, budget);
                if (projection.status === 'unavailable')
                    compact = { item: null, reason: projection.reason.code };
                else {
                    await work.step('projection');
                    const projectionJson = JSON.stringify(projection), decoded = decodeProjection(projectionJson, work.context);
                    work.authorized(decoded.value, dependencies);
                    const originals = [];
                    for (const id of [...decoded.evidence.keys()].sort()) {
                        await work.step('originals');
                        originals.push(work.original(id));
                    }
                    const encoded = encodeNativeReceipt({ schemaVersion: 'loredock-code-path-receipt/1', catalogId: store.receipts.catalogId,
                        projectionJson, originals, dependencies }, store.receipts.catalogId, budget);
                    receipt = encoded.serialized;
                    compact = compactQuestionPath(context, encoded, budget);
                }
            }
            catch (error) {
                if (!(error instanceof SelectionUnavailable))
                    throw error;
                selection = error.observation;
                compact = { item: null, reason: error.code };
            }
            for (const span of context.spans) {
                await work.step('originals');
                const original = work.original(span.id);
                requireReceipt(original.buildId === context.buildId && same(inputSpan(original), span), 'QUESTION_ORIGINAL_MISMATCH');
            }
            const prompt = preparedQuestionPrompt(context, compact.item);
            budget.charge('receipt', bytes(prompt));
            const witness = { schemaVersion: questionWitnessVersion, compositionVersion: questionPreparationVersion,
                promptVersion: questionPromptVersion, catalogId: store.receipts.catalogId, lexicalInputHash: context.inputHash,
                receipt, compact, selection, dependencies, sourceIds, prompt, promptHash: hash(prompt) };
            const snapshot = questionSnapshot(context, witness, budget);
            await work.step('handoff');
            assertQuestionCurrent(catalog, context, sourceIds);
            authorizeQuestionScope(work, context, witness);
            work.check();
            requireReceipt(this.shared.entry === entry && !this.shared.stopped && !signal.aborted, 'CANCELLED');
            // No await between the final authority fence and publishing owned immutable bytes.
            entry.snapshot = snapshot;
            entry.expires = performance.now() + questionPreparationLimits.readyMs;
            entry.state = { ...entry.state, status: 'ready', reviewedHash: snapshot.reviewedHash };
            const expire = () => {
                if (this.shared.entry !== entry)
                    return;
                const remaining = entry.expires - performance.now();
                if (remaining <= 0)
                    this.discard('expired', 'QUESTION_EXPIRED');
                else {
                    entry.timer = setTimeout(expire, Math.ceil(remaining));
                    entry.timer.unref();
                }
            };
            entry.timer = setTimeout(expire, questionPreparationLimits.readyMs);
            entry.timer.unref();
        }
        finally {
            budget?.close();
            this.observation = { id: entry.state.id, budget: budget?.stats() ?? null, lexical: lexical?.stats() ?? null, nativeReads };
            if (paths)
                void paths.stop();
        }
    }
    cancel(id) {
        const entry = this.find(id);
        if (entry === this.shared.entry)
            this.discard('cancelled', 'CANCELLED');
        return this.get(id);
    }
    async idle() { await this.shared.active?.done; }
    metrics() { return this.observation ? structuredClone(this.observation) : null; }
    reserveConfiguration() {
        this.busy();
        const token = Symbol('question-configuration');
        this.shared.configuration = token;
        return { release: () => { if (this.shared.configuration === token)
                delete this.shared.configuration; },
            check: () => { if (this.shared.stopped || this.shared.configuration !== token)
                fail('QUESTION_LEASE_EXPIRED', 'This configuration reservation ended.'); } };
    }
    /** A future answer adapter supplies its synchronous transaction; rollback retains Ready. */
    promote(id, reviewedHash, commit) {
        this.busy();
        const { snapshot } = this.ready(id, reviewedHash), token = Symbol('question-answer');
        this.shared.answer = token;
        const release = () => { if (this.shared.answer === token)
            delete this.shared.answer; };
        try {
            const value = commit(Object.freeze({ ...snapshot }));
            if (isThenable(value)) {
                if (value instanceof Promise)
                    void value.catch(() => undefined);
                fail('ASYNC_QUESTION_PROMOTION', 'Question promotion must commit synchronously.');
            }
            this.discard('consumed', null);
            return { value, release };
        }
        catch (error) {
            release();
            throw error;
        }
    }
    async stop() { this.shared.stopped = true; this.discard('cancelled', 'SERVICE_STOPPED'); await this.shared.active?.done; this.unsubscribe(); }
}
